notes: Mobile Harness Code — independent fork of Mobile Harness. v1.7.0: self-host Git providers join GitHub. Connect Gitea or OneDev with a personal access token (stored encrypted in the app vault, never in logs), then browse, search, create and clone public or private repositories — the clone reuses the existing Git + SSH stack. A central GitProviderManager keeps the providers behind one interface, so a future own Git server is just one more adapter. GitHub integration is unchanged. This APK is SIGNED (V3-only, production key); install mobile-harness-online.apk.
